deltas.name: semio-framework-job
deltas.manifest:
[package]
workspace = "../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-job"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "The universal resumable InteractiveJob protocol: a synchronous, explicitly-resumable step(&mut StepContext) -> StepOutcome every interactive operation implements instead of running to completion in one call. Operation/Generation identity and commit validation, structured child jobs on top of the async crate's CancelToken parent-chain, the ten-event progress-stream vocabulary with its channel-policy matrix, direct semio-framework-trace watchdog/record_* integration (no duplicated instrumentation), a batch adapter so CLI/headless paths reuse the same job impl as the interactive path, and the synthetic torture-job conformance test. Design ticket 26/08/20/INTERACTIVE-JOB-RUNTIME-REFACTOR, packet P2a."

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "job"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
name = "semio_framework_job"
path = "🦀️.rs"

[features]
# 🧪️ Turns on `semio_framework_async::testkit::ManualRuntime` for this crate's own scope/runtime
# integration tests — same shape as `semio-framework-async`'s own `testkit` feature, always
# available under `cfg(test)` regardless of this flag.
testkit = ["semio-framework-async/testkit"]

[dependencies]
semio-framework-trace = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-value = { workspace = true }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true, features = ["testkit"] }
serde_json = { workspace = true }

deltas.name: semio-framework-pack
